notes.heading: Codification
notes.text: Section, act Sept. 1, 1937, ch. 897, § 1, 50 Stat. 900, which declared purpose of this subchapter for establishment of a reindeer industry, was omitted from the Code as being of special and not general application.

notes.heading: Short Title
notes.text: Act Sept. 1, 1937, ch. 897, 50 Stat. 900, which enacted this subchapter, was popularly known as the “Reindeer Industry Act of 1937”.

notes.heading: Repeals
notes.text: Act Sept. 1, 1937, ch. 897, § 17, 50 Stat. 902, which repealed provisions inconsistent with this subchapter, was omitted from the Code as being of special and not general application.

notes.heading: Authorization of Appropriations
notes.text: Act Sept. 1, 1937, ch. 897, § 16, 50 Stat. 902, which authorized the appropriation of $2,000,000 to carry out this subchapter, was omitted from the Code as being of special and not general application.
